evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts

observations.why: Directive issued in the present demands erasure of specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts), projecting a desired future state that is not yet actual — irrealis modality with concrete referents.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes

observations.why: Present-tense directive seeking a non-actual future state (knowledge removed); 'all knowledge of zeppelin routes' operates at a categorical rather than event-specific level — abstract construal.
